about_short_description.short_description: Inversion Semiconductor is engaged in the development of an advanced lithography platform for next-generation semiconductor applications.

product.name: Particle Accelerator Lithography Platform
product.description: A lithography system using a miniaturized particle accelerator to enable semiconductor manufacturing at physical scaling limits.

product.name: High Power Light Source
product.description: A light source component that delivers three times higher throughput per scanner and can power multiple scanners simultaneously.

product.name: Tunable Wavelength Light Source
product.description: A light source capable of generating 13.5nm EUV light and adaptable wavelengths to support transistor scaling to physical limits.

product.name: Critical Dimension Uniformity Improvement
product.description: A technology that improves critical dimension uniformity by over 25%, enhancing fabrication of high aspect ratio features in semiconductor devices.
